from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import fitz
import aspose.words_foss as aw
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.docx_writer import LdmDocxWriter
output=Path(sys.argv[1]);output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for mode in ("body","table"):
 paragraph=ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.FieldStart(),ldm.Run(text="OUTER_CODE"),ldm.FieldStart(),ldm.Run(text="INNER_CODE"),ldm.FieldSeparator(),ldm.Run(text="SECRET_INNER_RESULT"),ldm.FieldEnd(),ldm.Run(text="SECRET_OUTER_CODE"),ldm.FieldSeparator(),ldm.Run(text="VISIBLE_RESULT"),ldm.FieldEnd()])
 children=[ldm.Table(rows=[ldm.Row(cells=[ldm.Cell(paragraphs=[paragraph])])])] if mode=="table" else [paragraph]
 source=LdmDocxWriter().write_to_bytes(ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(body=ldm.Body(children=children))]))
 (output/(mode+".docx")).write_bytes(source)
 raw=aw.Document(BytesIO(source)).to_bytes("pdf");(output/(mode+".pdf")).write_bytes(raw)
 pdf=fitz.open(stream=raw,filetype="pdf")
 pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(1.5,1.5),clip=fitz.Rect(0,0,pdf[0].rect.width,160)).save(output/(mode+".png"))
 print(mode,repr(pdf[0].get_text().strip()))
